name: Exp_ColorPEMA_Digit_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorPEMA_Digit indicator, which uses a colored Price EMA (PEMA) with digit-based signal generation. It enters positions on color changes of the PEMA indicator, with built-in time filtering to restrict trading to specific sessions and an optional trailing stop mechanism for trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorPEMA_Digit指标进行交易，该指标使用带数字信号生成的彩色价格EMA(PEMA)。当PEMA指标颜色变化时开仓，内置时间过滤器限制交易时段，并可选移动止损机制进行仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于彩色价格EMA(PEMA)指标的颜色变化信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为当PEMA指标颜色从一种变为另一种时开仓，例如由跌转涨时做多、由涨转跌时做空。出场条件包括指标颜色反转信号平仓、移动止损触发平仓以及固定止损/止盈水平。仓位管理通过输入参数设定固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数设置，以及移动止损功能来保护已有利润。时间过滤器允许用户限定仅在特定交易时段内开仓，避免低流动性时段的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend-following signals generated by color changes of the Price EMA (PEMA) indicator. Entry conditions trigger when the PEMA indicator color switches from one state to another — going long on bullish color change and short on bearish color change. Exit conditions include closing positions on indicator color reversal, trailing stop activation, or reaching fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is managed through input parameters allowing either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based lot calculation. Money management features include configurable stop-loss and take-profit settings along with a trailing stop mechanism to protect accumulated profits. The built-in time filter restricts trading to user-specified sessions, avoiding low-liquidity periods and reducing exposure to unfavorable market conditions.
pros: 基于彩色PEMA指标的趋势跟踪逻辑清晰直观，易于理解和验证
内置时间过滤器可有效避免低流动性时段的虚假信号
移动止损机制有助于锁定利润，降低回撤风险
支持多种仓位管理方式，灵活性较高
信号基于指标颜色变化，减少了主观判断的干扰
pros_en: Clear and intuitive trend-following logic based on the colored PEMA indicator, easy to understand and verify
Built-in time filter effectively avoids false signals during low-liquidity sessions
Trailing stop mechanism helps lock in profits and reduce drawdown risk
Supports multiple position sizing methods, offering good flexibility
Signals based on indicator color changes reduce subjective judgment interference
cons: 单一指标依赖风险较高，缺乏多维度信号确认
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
未发现明显的价差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能不利
缺乏对新闻事件或极端波动行情的防护措施
参数较多且缺乏优化指导，用户可能难以找到最佳配置
cons_en: High risk of single-indicator dependency, lacking multi-dimensional signal confirmation
Trend-following strategy prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
No apparent spread filter mechanism, which may be disadvantageous in high-spread environments
Lacks protection against news events or extreme volatility conditions
Many parameters without optimization guidance, making it difficult for users to find optimal settings
improvements: 增加多指标确认机制（如RSI、MACD）以减少虚假信号
添加价差过滤和波动率过滤，避免不利市场条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add multi-indicator confirmation (e.g., RSI, MACD) to reduce false signals
Add spread filter and volatility filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable market conditions

risk_points: 单一指标依赖在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损
缺乏价差过滤在高点差环境下可能侵蚀利润
时间过滤器配置不当可能错过重要交易机会或在不当时段开仓
risk_points_en: Single indicator dependency may cause consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lack of spread filter may erode profits in high-spread environments
Improper time filter configuration may miss important trading opportunities or open positions during unfavorable sessions

summary_en: This EA trades based on the ColorPEMA_Digit indicator, which uses a colored Price EMA (PEMA) with digit-based signal generation. It enters positions on color changes of the PEMA indicator, with built-in time filtering to restrict trading to specific sessions and an optional trailing stop mechanism for trade management.
